scope: Independent read-only review; no solver or model/script/frozen mutation. Snapshot only while other streams may run. Not kernel acceptance.

observer_review.evidence: observer calls get_target/get_index/get_results/get_gid/is_smoke_test/is_trivial and iter_on_goals; local wpo.ml is_trivial reads Conditions.is_trivial; no reduce/resolve/compute or set_result call. It writes JSONL and registers hooks only.
observer_review.normal_exit_limit: Boot.Main.extend marker alone is insufficient: require process exit 0 and final counts/IDs consistent.

quick_main_streamed_partial.meaning: Partial bounded diagnostic only. No-results means no recorded prover result, not proof failure. Main phase exit124 and no normal marker.

findings.detail: stream.py input_unchanged checks baseline files+annotated hashes but not current proof.patch, external lock members, observer binary/source, or runner post-run. Recheck recorded hashes independently after all phases. Snapshot checks here all pass; do not silently equate input_unchanged to full model_inputs_unchanged.
Classify cfg-only using explicit prover=cfg results, never trivial boolean. GEMM body final1205=1175 logic+30 cfg; trivial flag116 is not cfg count.

Killed quick phase supplies only lower-bound observed successes. Use latest modified event per exact goal, restricted to inventory IDs; do not turn absent/unseen into solver failure or 0/0 success. A final event batch without marker after timeout remains incomplete.

Require inventory-body and inventory-lemmas both exit0, normal marker, unique final IDs count equal marker, source/model/proof/observer guards and accepted control. Solver-free raw.json absent is expected; final metadata is the enumeration authority.

No-qed/no-clean inventory and z3 one-second/1000-step quick options differ from canonical full checker. Even all quick goals valid cannot replace complete/raw coverage/body/global obligations/strict controls acceptance.

recommended_aggregation.within_phase: Deduplicate modified events by exact goal ID; for completed phases use final events only. A modified-only goal may be transient; reconcile against complete inventory. Preserve smoke separately.
recommended_aggregation.property_not_unique: An invariant property may have established and preserved WPOs; never aggregate by property alone. Source basename/line/function are classification metadata, not cross-version identity.
coverage_checks: Every inventory final unique and count matches marker; body versus global disjoint/explicitly deduped.
Extract all declared ACSL lemmas from annotated inputs and compare lemma inventory properties.
Compare actual reachable body/callee definitions and ghost helper roots with expected body contracts/ensures coverage from existing checker; normal exit only covers requested selection.
Verify quick-helper/main/lemma ID unions against inventory, report missing/unmatched IDs instead of assuming equal denominators.
If quick raw exists with normal exit, verify raw IDs/results reconcile to non-CFG observer finals; preserve raw verdict verbatim.
Check public wrapper ensures and NEON/RVV inlined source-origin goals remain present; CFG-only termination/exits cannot stand in for body ensures.
Keep positive/negative control isolated from kernel totals; require accepted control plus normal exit and guard reconciliation.
